notes.title: Update 14. Mai
notes.content:
- Blood Overlay in Map "Dark Dungeon" added
- Spawn Sound changed for Werepigs

notes.title: Small Update Version 1.3
notes.content:
- New Weapon: "Baby Davy Crockett" (the ultimate Deamon exorcism Weapon)
- Werehogs with Gun's
- More Blood and Splatter
- Message from Master Sergeant A. Washington in the "Guide" (he is the operations manager from WOM and the Boss from Ram Ganger)
- Reduced Build size

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- Difficulty very easy available (in the Settings). With the Difficulty very easy this game is also suitable for beginer in Shooter games.
- If you change the weapon, the weapons without ammo will be skipped
- Guide in the Main Menue available

notes.title: Update: 17.09.2022
notes.content:
- 2 new Maps (Psychiatric Hospital and House)

- Performance improvement

- Bugfix in Pagoda Map (Player stick in the ground in some places)

- "Look sensibility / Mouse sensibility" is now availbale in the Settings

- Enemy spawning and balancing changed

- Demon Sound changed (less "Groar...")

notes.title: Update 3. September
notes.content:
New Maps:
- Medieval Random Dungeon
- Medieval Ruins

notes.title: New Map and Bugfixing
notes.content:
- A new Map with Random generated Dungeons available (Grim Random Dungeon)
- Bugfix while kill an Dragon with the Multi Rocket Launcher
- Light in Temple Map changed

notes.title: Update 22.06.2022
notes.content:
- New Weapon: Shoot the souls out of the demons with the "Desouler"
- 60 Steam achievements
- Extended controller support: Pause and ESC are mapped to the controller
- Steam Overlay integration: The game pauses when the Steam overlay is open
- Internal testing on Steam Deck: The game runs on the Steam deck using the controller sticks and buttons. However, the menus have to be operated with the touchpad
- The weapons are now arranged in a clear order

notes.title: Update 13.06.2022
notes.content:
- All weapons immediately available
- Difficulty level Easily available in the Settings (but on level Easily no awards are achievable)
- Controller now has pause and ESC support
- Shotgun accuracy improved at close range
- Weregoat is easier to split up
